reason: The weighty bills add duties for health funds toward patients: treatment within a reasonable time, ambulance and travel refunds, subsidised oxygen, lower prescription co-payments at any pharmacy, choice of provider, reasoned replies to refusals, transferring medical records between funds, and ending the exclusion of soldiers. The statement and its examples match this, and the price (higher health insurance costs) is the real trade-off. Only #6 (capping parking fees at medical institutions, a traffic law) is off-topic and it is light.
